title: Extend depth sweep: DEPTH=10 -> 12
description: Set DEPTH=12 (model_dim=768, 6 heads) and reduced DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE from 128 to 64 (grad_accum_steps 2->8) to keep VRAM under budget.
reflection: val_bpb regressed to 1.016225, worse than both the depth=10 baseline (1.002279) and the original depth=8 baseline (1.014027). The depth=8->10 trend did not continue to depth=12; the extra grad_accum steps (smaller device batch, same total batch) may have also hurt by increasing per-step overhead/noise, so this result confounds two variables. Either way, depth=12 (at least with this batch config) is a clear loss. Recommend the group treat depth=10 as a local optimum and stop pushing depth further without first re-testing depth=12 at the original DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE=128 if VRAM allows, or explore a different lever entirely (width, window pattern, LR schedule) instead.
